summary: The operator has no website; its Facebook page (the entry's website) gives 54 campsites from primitive to water + electric, 4 cabins, phone (814) 257-0131 (matches) and campmiltonloop@gmail.com. Added water hookups at some sites and the 54-site count. Not stated: amperage, rates, season, booking method beyond the phone, dump station, max length. The only post visible logged out is from November 2023. No county or USACE page for the campground was found.
flags: No operator rate, season or 2024+ dated information is reachable: the only presence is a Facebook page (logged out it shows the intro and a November 2023 post). Town/county parks are exempt from the web-presence removal rule, so this is information only.

Internal waterfront inconsistency, not from an operator claim: stored waterfront 'riverview', but the --Claude note says the campground is 'separated from the water by a band of woods - no real water view and no direct water access', and the water is Mahoning Creek Lake (a reservoir), not a river. Worth a waterfront re-check.
